# Varryal EML AdminTool 2.7.0-varryal.3

Based on upstream EML AdminTool 2.7.0.

## Varryal changes

- Stabilize Optional Mods management, including scrolling, search, aligned metadata fields and reliable save/reload behavior.
- Introduce explicit fork version metadata in `varryal.json`.
- Disable direct upstream self-updates so Varryal-specific changes cannot be overwritten.
- Keep upstream release discovery as informational status in AdminTool settings.
- Add CI verification for Prisma generation, Svelte/type checks and production builds.
- Harden the release workflow to require `X.Y.Z-varryal.N` versions and matching upstream metadata.
- Define a reviewed upstream-sync process before integrating future EML releases.
